name: menu
title: Menu
description: Actions menu using the disclosure pattern on the native popover attribute.

a11y.pattern: Disclosure: button[popovertarget][aria-expanded] + div[popover] of buttons and links
keyboard: Opens the menu and focuses the first item
Closes the menu and returns focus to the button
Moves on and closes the menu when focus leaves it
aria: aria-expanded on the trigger mirrors the popover state
Icon-only trigger takes the label as aria-label
Items are native buttons or links; no role=menu is used
a11y.notes: This is a disclosure of actions, not an application menu bar. Use links for navigation and buttons for actions. Requires the popover attribute (all current browsers).
